# <span id="aanchor302"></span> Quality Assignment Editor

The Quality Assignment Editor is used to view, create, and maintain source-to-meter and source-to-location assignments. An assignment causes source analysis data to be applied to the assigned meters and to tickets of assigned locations.

The editor is also used to configure the “Send To” capability that allows meter or location analysis data to be sent to a source. Sending location data is the implementation of a calculated source since the location will be the volume weighted average of its members’ analyses.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Quality Assignment Editor:

- Go to **Setup** \> **Source Analysis** \> **Quality Assignments**; or
- Click the **Quality Assignments** shortcut tile 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="vertical-align: text-bottom;width: 15;height: 19;" />.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 713;height: 404;" />

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Quality Assignment Editor Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The standard **object selector** allows users to select meters, locations, lists, sources and source lists.

- If you select "Meter", existing assignments for the meter will display.
- If you select "Location", the following options will display:
  - **By Meter** - The location will be treated as a list of meters. Only immediate meter members of the location are available. Use the navigation buttons to scroll through the list; the currently selected meter displays in the title bar of the window.

    Meter assignments are maintained individually. Source assignments can be set for multiple meters using [Bulk Changes](../../Tools/Bulk%20Changes.md).

  - **By Location** - The location will be treated as a list of locations. The selected location and all locations below it in the hierarchy are available. Use the navigation buttons to scroll through the available locations; the currently selected location displays in the title bar of the window.
- If you select "List", the following options will display:
  - **By Meter** - A scrollable list of all of the list’s member meters and all the meters of each location hierarchy will display. Use the navigation buttons to scroll through the available meters; the currently selected meter displays in the title bar of the window.
  - **By Location** - The selected location and the locations in the hierarchy will display. Use the navigation buttons to scroll through the available locations; the currently selected location displays in the title bar of the window.
- If you select "Source", existing assignments for the source will display.
- If you select "Source List", a scrollable list of sources will display. Use the navigation buttons to scroll through the available sources; the currently selected source displays in the title bar of the window.

The **assignment grid** displays details about the assignment, including meter, source, and effective dates.

The **Send To group box** contains configuration options for sending meter or location data to a source.

The **assignment configuration buttons** provide functionality options including creating, editing, or deleting an assignment.

</div>
